name: Star Ferry Dawn Crossing
approach: Arrive two ferries early to watch the crew prepare the deck.
exit_cue: Twice the bell rings for final boarding.
sound: Low engine thrum, gulls passing in counterpoint.
access: Step-free from pier 7 lift, incline at gangway 1:20.

research.claim: Observed 4-minute queue with step-free boarding slope 1:20.
research.evidence: Ticket timestamp 05:42 + inclinometer reading noted in field log.
research.method: Timed entry to departure with synchronized recorder; slope measured using Suunto PM-5.

composition.staging: Board two departures early, hold to starboard so the sunrise frames the skyline.
composition.approach: Follow crew prep rhythm to sync footfalls with engine wake.
composition.exit: Disembark after second horn to stay ahead of commuters.

name: Sheung Wan Wet Market Galleries
approach: Take the moving walkway up three flights, left at the citrus stand.
exit_cue: When the mezzanine lamps flicker on for lunch rush.
sound: Vendors calling in bright thirds, chopping block rhythm.
access: Lift at entrance B, narrow aisles midday.

research.claim: Logged 68 dB average and 2 min 10 s queue for lift B at 12:04.
research.evidence: Sound meter LEQ on Zoom F3, lift CCTV timestamp via attendant log.
research.method: Stationary measurement with tripod mic, verified queue using synced photo timestamps.

composition.staging: Ride lift B, pause on mezzanine to sample pomelo, trace catwalk shadow bands.
composition.approach: Arrive via escalator to align with vendor chorus.
composition.exit: Slip out when neon flickers on.

name: Central Harbourfront Lawn
approach: Loop the footbridge to stay above the traffic wash.
exit_cue: Ferry horn three times from Kowloon pier.
sound: Balancing acts of busking violin and harbor wind.
access: Ramp entry at Tamar Park, benches every 15m.

research.claim: Comfort score 4.2/5 with shade sail deployed and wind 6 kt.
research.evidence: Shade/seat checklist completed 19:12, HKO wind archive Sai Wan station.
research.method: Comfort rubric logged every 10 minutes; cross-checked with weather API download.

composition.staging: Lay the mat facing east, cue field recorder on tripod for arriving ferries.
composition.approach: Loop footbridge to skim above traffic wash.
composition.exit: Pack after third horn from Kowloon pier.
